narrative: Inventory optimization completed for material PL1__M8DC1260. The analysis shows a smooth demand pattern with normal distribution (CV=0.44). Lead time exhibits unstable behavior (CV=0.41). The recommended safety stock of 1107 units provides 95% service level protection against demand and lead time variability. The optimized order quantity of 2731 units balances ordering costs ($2285.79/year) and holding costs ($3773.50/year), yielding total annual costs of $6059.29 compared to the previous policy baseline of $28838.82, representing a 79.0% cost reduction ($22779.53 annual savings). The reorder point is set at 2478 units with a review period of 6 days. The capacity constraint is satisfied (3838 ≤ 3839).

research_insights.selected_model: EOQ with stochastic lead time demand
research_insights.selection_rationale: Given the smooth demand pattern with CV=0.44 and unstable lead time variability (CV=0.41), the classical EOQ model with safety stock based on lead time demand uncertainty is appropriate. The normal distribution assumption is justified by the coefficient of variation.
research_insights.boundary_risk: The order quantity is constrained by storage capacity (available: 2732 units after safety stock). The EOQ recommendation of 2860 was reduced to 2731 to fit capacity, which may increase total costs slightly but is operationally necessary.
